project.name: identity-signing
project.description:
The single implementation of gateway-minted identity signing.
ApiGateway mints the X-Identity-Signature header and every service verifies it by recomputing, so both sides must agree byte-for-byte or every authenticated request 403s. They previously held separate copies of this logic because ApiGateway cannot depend on common-library: that drags spring-boot-starter-web onto the classpath and Spring Cloud Gateway refuses to start, via GatewayClassPathWarningAutoConfiguration's SpringMvcFoundOnClasspathConfiguration.
This module exists so that neither side owns the logic. It deliberately depends on spring-context and nothing else: no web stack, no persistence, no messaging, so it is safe for both a reactive gateway and a servlet service. Keep it that way. Any dependency added here lands in all 19 deployables, and a web dependency would recreate the exact problem this module was built to solve.
The package stays com.fooddelivery.common.security so the existing scanBasePackages and ComponentScan declarations of all 20 applications keep finding the bean unchanged.
